proof:
constructor
· intro k
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
· intro f hf
  have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal (f k)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (ENNReal.ofReal (0 : ℝ))) :=
    ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hf
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using h
